principles: Plan only — describe future work, implement no source code
Code-verified — every existing-system claim and anchor must match the real repo
Determinism-preserving — the layer is advisory-only and never touches gate logic
Reuse over rebuild — extend dev-memory / clone decision-doc digest / reuse activity-log
Match house convention — English freeform execution-plan format
drivers: The decisions/ corpus is uniformly English freeform execution-plan markdown
The doc must not mislead: anchors and existing-system claims must be accurate
No Co-Authored-By trailer; all changes via the Lattice workflow

options.name: freeform-english-execution-plan
pros: Matches every existing doc in docs/requirements/decisions/ (house convention)
Preserves the rich multi-section v1.1 content (module decomposition, reuse, guardrails, roadmap, anchors)
Easy for reviewers and future implementers to read and diff
cons: Accuracy is defended by review rather than by the compiler
Requires manual discipline to keep code anchors correct

options.name: structured-decision-doc-proposal-save
pros: Built-in proposalDigest integrity and freshness binding
cons: Regenerates the doc from fixed structured fields, losing the multi-section roadmap prose
Designed for a single durable decision statement, not a multi-section execution plan

rationale: Every existing doc in decisions/ is freeform English execution-plan markdown, and this is a multi-section roadmap rather than a single durable decision; the structured proposal path would flatten the content and break house consistency.

preMortem.scenario: Code anchors in the doc drift from the real code
preMortem.trigger: Copying file paths or line numbers that no longer match
preMortem.consequence: The doc misleads future implementers about where to hook
preMortem.mitigation: Verifier asserts each anchored file exists; docs reviewer spot-checks paths against the repo

preMortem.scenario: The doc reads as if it implements code rather than planning it
preMortem.trigger: Imperative phrasing without a plan-only scope note
preMortem.consequence: Scope confusion; scope-contract or reviewers flag it
preMortem.mitigation: Explicit plan-only scope note in the header and a scope contract limited to the single doc

preMortem.scenario: Determinism framing is weakened during English authoring
preMortem.consequence: A future implementer could let learning influence a gate
preMortem.mitigation: Dedicated determinism-guardrails section enumerating all three guardrails; reviewer verifies presence

preMortem.scenario: A Co-Authored-By trailer slips into a commit or the doc
preMortem.mitigation: Explicit no-trailer rule; verifier greps the doc and the commit messages are authored without trailers
